# omniddi_dns_zone (Data Source)

Reads one DNS zone by id, or by name within a view.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_dns_zone" "by_id" {
  id = 34
}

data "omniddi_dns_zone" "by_name" {
  name      = "corp.example.com"
  view_name = "internal"
}

data "omniddi_dns_zone" "by_view_id" {
  name    = "corp.example.com"
  view_id = 12
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI zone id. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Zone name, compared case-insensitively and without a trailing dot. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`; with `name`, also set `view_id` or `view_name`.
- `view_id` (Number) Id of the view that holds the zone. With `name`, set this or `view_name`.
- `view_name` (String) Name of the view that holds the zone. With `name`, set this or `view_id`.

### Read-Only

- `auto_create_ptr_records` (Boolean) Whether PTR records are created automatically.
- `business_unit_ids` (List of Number) Business unit ids; the first is the primary one.
- `cidr` (String) Network of a `Reverse` zone.
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `dynamic_dns_tsig_key_id` (Number) TSIG key id used for dynamic DNS.
- `email` (String) SOA contact address.
- `enable_dnssec` (Boolean) Whether DNSSEC is enabled.
- `enable_dynamic_dns` (Boolean) Whether dynamic DNS is enabled.
- `enable_zone_transfer` (Boolean) Whether zone transfers are allowed.
- `expiry` (Number) SOA expire time in seconds.
- `minimum` (Number) SOA minimum TTL in seconds.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Forward targets of a `Forward` zone.
- `network_scope` (String) Network scope: `Internal` or `External`.
- `policy` (String) Forward policy of a `Forward` zone.
- `primary_name_server` (String) SOA primary name server.
- `primary_servers` (Attributes List) Primary servers of a `Secondary` zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--primary_servers))
- `protocol` (String) IP protocol of a `Reverse` zone.
- `records_count` (Number) Number of records in the zone.
- `refresh` (Number) SOA refresh interval in seconds.
- `retry` (Number) SOA retry interval in seconds.
- `secondary_sync_tsig_key_id` (Number) TSIG key id used by a `Secondary` zone to sync.
- `secure_sync` (Boolean) Whether a `Secondary` zone uses TSIG-secured transfers.
- `soa_serial` (Number) Current SOA serial.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued tags on the zone. Not populated by the plural data source.
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued tags on the zone. Not populated by the plural data source.
- `ttl` (Number) Default TTL in seconds.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `zone_transfer_tsig_key_id` (Number) TSIG key id used for zone transfers.
- `zone_type` (String) Zone type: `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Forward` or `Reverse`.

<a id="nestedatt--primary_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `primary_servers`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Server address.
- `port` (Number) Server port.
- `tsig_key_id` (Number) TSIG key id securing the transfer.
